SHOPWARE_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the Shopware admin backend (username: admin). Auto-generated per deployment; the well-known default is rotated to this value on first boot. Find it in the service variables.

SHOP_DOMAIN.description: Public domain of the shop (auto-filled by Railway once a domain is attached). Sales-channel URLs are rewritten to it on boot.

SW_CURRENCY.description: Default shop currency (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP). Leave as not-set to keep the install default.

SW_TASKS_ENABLED.description: Run Shopware scheduled tasks and message-queue workers via cron (recommended: powers order flows, index updates, and mail).

TZ.description: Container timezone for log stamps and scheduled tasks.

TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: IPs/CIDRs Railway's edge proxy connects from (it terminates TLS and forwards plain HTTP). Symfony trusts X-Forwarded-Proto from these so the shop sees the real https scheme. Private ranges are safe: the container port isn't directly reachable.
